title: Heart
description: A hollow, inflated heart balloon, drawn from the tip upward.

title: Ring
description: A diamond ring: band, prongs, then the faceted stone filling in.

title: Bottle
description: A longneck beer bottle: heel, body, shoulder and neck rise, then the crown cap closes it.

title: Wine glass
description: A tulip wine glass: foot and stem first, then the hollow bowl fills up.

title: Knight
description: A chess knight: a horse head and neck, with ears, mane and eye, on a round pedestal.

title: Teapot
description: A teapot with a curved spout, a loop handle and a domed lid with a knob.

title: Hourglass
description: An hourglass: pinched glass bulbs on two plates, three posts and a mound of sand.

title: Light bulb
description: A light bulb: glass globe, threaded screw base and a looping filament.

title: Möbius band
description: A Möbius band: a wide ribbon that twists once, so the loop has a single side.

title: Trefoil knot
description: A trefoil knot: one thick tube that crosses itself three times.

title: Klein bottle
description: A Klein bottle: a pear-shaped bulb whose neck bends over and re-enters through its own wall.

title: DNA
description: A DNA double helix: two strands wind up, joined by base pairs.

title: Nautilus
description: A nautilus shell: a ribbed tube that grows by a fixed factor each turn.

title: Planet
description: A ringed planet with a moon: banded globe, two rings and a gap between them.

title: Paper plane
description: A folded paper plane built from flat, paper-thin facets.

title: Crown
description: A crown with five points, a rim ring and a jewel on every point.

title: Key
description: An old key: round bow, collared shaft and a toothed bit.

title: Heart and arrow
description: The heart balloon pierced by an arrow, with the heart hiding the middle of the shaft.
